title: refuse ryuen coalition
context: Year 1 Volume 4 first-year shipboard Zodiac/VIP test. Primary actor action only, gated by personal knowledge at scene time.
observed_actions: Questions Ryūen's claim of a school-created group hierarchy and refuses a tactical alliance because of prior harm and trust risks.
observed_result: The proposed B–C coordination is not formed in that discussion.
epistemic_limits: This refusal is specific to the proposal and evidence, not blanket refusal of every future alliance.
information_available: No unearned actor memories from later reveals, private confessions, other groups or alternate future timelines.
counterfactual_test: Change actor knowledge, physical context, privileges and incentives; allow failures. Do not treat violent or sexual coercion as required, endorsed or reliable.
